**v1.12.0: the bot reads the game again after Wizard101's 2026-11-12 patch, gets back online by itself after server maintenance, and gains carry mode (two clients on one PC) and teleport-to-leader for parties.**

**Update this one first.** Wizard101's 2026-11-12 patch (client build 6AF1C8A0-3B69000) broke part of the helper's read of the game's memory. On v1.11.2 against the patched game:
- the bot gets no hand, deck or backpack from the game, and plays only the cards it has pictures for;
- quest goal names come through as numbers, and the goal line is read off the screen;
- the quest helper isn't read.

Battles go noticeably worse as a result.

- **Fixed: memory reading on the patched game.**
  - **Why it broke:** the new game build keeps other registers at 0, which the readers didn't expect.
    - Card effects and targets came out wrong.
    - Quest goal kinds and statuses came out wrong.
    - Equipment sets weren't found.
    - Two quest-helper signatures are gone from the build.
  - **How it was fixed:** the readers now accept any register. The quest helper falls back to its old slots, and each one is checked by its window or thread name before use.
  - **Checked:** on the running game (read-only), the hand, worn deck, quest goals and quest helper read again. Old and new code agree on 725 property offsets across 87 classes.
- **Fixed: back online after server maintenance.**
  - **What was wrong:** the maintenance box ("Server has been brought down for maintenance") has OK but no RECONNECT button, so auto-reconnect waited on it forever (14 hours on 2026-11-12).
  - **What it does now:**
    - After 20 minutes on that box it closes Wizard101 and starts it again with your saved login (tray menu: Set Wizard101 login...). It asks once, and goes ahead after 60 seconds if nobody answers.
    - While the servers stay down it keeps trying, for up to 12 hours.
    - A maintenance message while logging in isn't taken as a wrong login.
    - With no saved login, it tells you once (in debug.log, plus a Discord alert if those are set up).
- **New: carry mode (Alt+K).** Level one wizard while a strong one does the fighting, with both logged in on the same PC.
  - **Setup:** put the strong wizard on the main wizard's mount, click the main wizard's window and press Alt+K.
  - **In battle:** the main passes each round. The bot brings up the carry's window, plays its round and switches back. Afterwards the carry presses X to get back on the mount.
  - **Memory reading:** each wizard is read from its own client.
  - **Not handled yet:** the carry getting disconnected, and potions for the carry.
- **New: party followers teleport to the leader and ride its mount.**
  - **Teleport (`partytp`, on):** a follower that is lost, or stuck five times on the way, teleports to the leader with the game's Group button.
  - **Ride (`partyride`, on):** next to the leader, a follower presses X at the prompt to ride the leader's mount.
  - **Clicks:** every click target comes from the game's memory and is checked before it's clicked.
- **Fixed: extra off-school blades and traps are discarded.** Example: an Elemental Blade or Elemental Trap with no Hydra in hand. The bot keeps one copy for the hit it fits and discards the rest, one a look, when nothing else was discarded. Before, they could fill the hand for a dozen rounds. Switch it off with `discardunused` 0.
- **Potion shop:**
  - **Found by memory:** Fill All and BUY are found by the game's memory first, and a cost of 0 after Fill All means your potions are full.
  - **Small UI sizes:** BUY is also found where the on-screen words miss it, as at UI size 0.856.
- **Fixed: rounds missed after a restart out of battle.** The UI size is now measured again when the game's log says a round is up but no Pass button has been seen. Before, a restart out of battle at a new window size could miss every round of a battle.
- **The Settings window can be resized:** let go of its edge and the settings are laid out again to fit.
- **New: StreamView.ahk.** Share "Wiz-Maxxing stream view" in Discord or OBS to show the game with the bot's overlay. The overlay itself is kept out of screen capture so the bot never reads its own drawing.
- **Not tried in the game yet:** carry mode, the party teleport and ride, and the maintenance restart (it was tested against the real maintenance line from the game's log, with the game itself stubbed). debug.log lines start "Carry:", "Party:" and "Reconnect:".
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
